Body.Content:
As previously announced in the Power Platform admin center on October 30th, 2026, data export (preview) is deprecated and will be retired in phases. Inventory data export stops on December 1, 2026. Usage and environment data exports aren't affected by this change and continue to function as they do today. These will be retired at a later date, with advance notice. Data you've already exported is not affected by this change and will stay in your data lake.

How does this affect me?
  • Inventory data: Starting December 1, 2026, new inventory data won't be exported to your Azure Data Lake Storage account. Reports and processes that depend on inventory data export will stop receiving updates.
  • Usage and environment data: No changes at this time. Existing exports will continue to run, and you can still set up new ones.
What action do I need to take?
To keep getting inventory data, switch to the Power Platform inventory API before December 1, 2026. Before you migrate, compare data export and the inventory API. No action is needed for usage and environment data exports at this time.

Title: Power Platform admin center - Inventory data export (preview) stops December 1, 2026
